P22w: Any humane membership process should have ways of not turning every limit into a flat-out rejection, like saying “later,” or “in another role,” or “with more support.”
P13p2w: There is a difficult paradox to consider. The need for new members in a small community is greater, but the ability of that community to tolerate the disruption of new members is less. With only eight people in the community, someone still has to grow the food, fix whatever breaks, balance the books, watch the kids, and maintain the water system. The water well doesn’t care how beautiful someone’s heart is.
P22x: Any humane membership process should have ways of not flat-out rejecting people every time it hits a limit, like saying “later,” or “in another role,” or “with more support.”
P22y: Any humane membership process should have ways of not flat-out rejecting people who fall into these categories, or anyone else it can’t take right now, like saying “later,” or “in another role,” or “with more support.”
